verdict.rationale: Graphite lists 'Automations' as a pricing-tier feature, so the axis applies. However, no evidence shows that automation definitions can be versioned, reviewed, or rolled back. Its git-based stacking, PR review and AI review features cover users' code changes, not the automations themselves, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
